rows.grounds: Refers to one's own prescribed duty; taken with niratāḥ as the object of devotion.
Describes those engaged or absorbed in their own duty.
Qualifies the subjects as calm or tranquil.
Locative adverb referring to the previously mentioned context or state.
Main verb indicating abiding or remaining.
Subject noun denoting those who uphold dharma.

items.question: Which qualities characterize the righteous people who dwell in that state?
premises: The righteous are devoted to their own duty.
The righteous are peaceful in disposition.
items.inference: Those who dwell there are defined as righteous by their devotion to their own duty and their peacefulness.
uncertainties: The referent of tatra depends on the preceding verses and is not fully specified within this verse.
items.plain_english: Devoted to their own duty and peaceful, the righteous dwell there.
